title: Artless Sprite
meta_description: Walk to Beach & Grayton Beach- Artless Sprite by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Artless Sprite by Royal Destinations Location: Grayton Beach Address: 156 Garfield Street Details: Artless Sprite is a beautifully renovated historic bungalow located in the heart of Old Grayton Beach and bordering Grayton Beach State Park. Completely renovated from the studs and professionally decorated, this charming 1,232-square-foot retreat blends the character of historic Grayton Beach with updated finishes and modern comforts. Accommodating up to 8 guests, the home features three bedrooms, two full baths, an open-concept living area, and a beautifully equipped kitchen. One of Artless Sprite’s greatest highlights is its exceptional location. The Western Lake public beach access is less than a three-minute walk from the home, with iconic Grayton Beach destinations including The Red Bar and The Zoo Gallery just minutes away. Whether spending the day along the sugar-white sand, exploring nearby Grayton Beach State Park, or enjoying the restaurants and local character of Old Grayton, Artless Sprite puts you in the heart of one of 30A’s most beloved communities. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: Less Than 3-Minute Walk to Western Lake Public Beach Access -Distance to The Red Bar and The Zoo Gallery: Approximately 2-Minute Walk -Parking Spaces: (2) -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 8 -Coffee Maker Available -Prime Old Grayton Beach Location -Borders Grayton Beach State Park -Outdoor Porches -Outdoor Shower -Outdoor Gas Grill Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 8 3 Bedrooms / 2 Baths First Floor: -Bedroom 1 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Walk-In Shower, Double Vanity) -Bedroom 2: Queen Bed with Shared Full Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Bedroom 3 (Bunk Room): (2) Twin XL/Twin XL Bunks with Shared Full Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Kitchen / Living Room / Dining Area Please Note: *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
